scripts.format:backend: black backend/app backend/tests && ruff check backend/app backend/tests --fix
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.lint:backend: ruff check backend/app backend/tests && mypy backend/app
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend

scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend

scripts.all: npm run check && npm run test
